paragraphs: BriefCam sells video analytics software that makes recorded surveillance video searchable, actionable and quantifiable. Its patented VIDEO SYNOPSIS technology condenses hours of surveillance into a short summary by overlaying multiple events, each tagged with its original timestamp, onto a single frame that users can filter by object type and attributes. The software is camera-agnostic, integrates with video management systems such as XProtect, and also works as a standalone solution for agencies that only need file-based review.

Three modules, Review, Respond and Research, are used respectively for post-incident search, real-time alerts and quantifying data trends. Every customer needs Review as a base and can then add Respond, Research or both. License plate recognition works on any camera, with no need for dedicated LPR licenses per camera. For commercial users, people counting tracks queues and crowd movement and measures occupancy to improve space use and traffic flow.

BriefCam serves law enforcement, transportation, retail and more, across public and private sectors. Customer stories on the site cover Tlaxcala, Mexico, Villa El Salvador and the City of Hartford's real-time crime center. The site is published by Milestone Systems, which lists BriefCam among its products alongside the XProtect video management software.
